policies.title: Nepali ordinary passports: Grenada advance visitor visa
policies.summary: Grenada's live Embassy-linked nationality schedule lists Nepal as requiring a visa prior to arrival.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nepali passport holder travelling as a short visitor.
Grenada defines Prior to Arrival as a visa obtained at a Grenada mission or consulate before travel.
The active Embassy schedule is marked updated April 2024; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, transit, diplomatic, official, service, special-document and final-admission treatment are outside scope.

policies.title: Nepali ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule names Nepal in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless its separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Nepali passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Apply in person at the competent Panamanian consulate before travel; the Embassy says approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on document verification and completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Submit authorized-visa documents in person to the competent Panamanian consulate before travel.
Travel only after the consular visa has been granted.
